description: App secret values are sent in plain text by POST /v1/apps/{app_name}/secrets (values map) and POST /v1/apps/{app_name}/secrets/{secret_name} (value), and returned in plain text by GET /v1/apps/{app_name}/secrets?show_secrets=true and the set-secret response (value). The spec marks none of them sensitive, so the SDK took and returned plain strings that print and log. Observed live 2026-11-11 on a throwaway app: the secrets update response echoes `{ "secrets": [{ "name": "API_KEY", "value": "…", "digest": "…" }] }`.
